subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for both Control UI structured reply metadata and no-output terminal-state semantics, or should maintainers split it across the runtime reply metadata and final fallback delivery canonicals?
rationale: The remaining work changes protocol/runtime/session semantics and overlaps an open reply metadata PR plus an open maintainer fallback-delivery issue, so automation should not choose the permanent contract or issue split.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the structured reply metadata path and let the durable final fallback issue own no-output delivery semantics.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close this issue only after confirming the Control UI reply-metadata portion and no-output portion are fully tracked by narrower canonical issues or PRs.

options.title: Treat Markdown Reply As Sufficient
options.body: Accept the merged Markdown quote affordance as enough for Control UI and leave structured reply identity and fallback semantics entirely to other trackers.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the structured reply metadata path and let the durable final fallback issue own no-output delivery semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Control UI, gateway protocol, and agent runtime context boundaries where current-main blame and prior routing point to steipete as the best available owner.
